title: madeup_text caches a 429, 500 or 503 answer of the made-up sibling as a real 404, turning off soft-404 detection for the host
goal: factdiff.madeup_text keeps only a 200 or a 404 (or 410) answer of the made-up sibling for the host; any other status (429, 5xx) is not kept, so a later source of the host asks again and soft-404 detection stays on, as the sprint goal's 'a failed made-up-page request' asks. Found by the SP-vk3wf746 review (S3, factdiff.py:1059).

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import factdiff as f,provider as p;n=[0];p.gated_request=lambda u,**k:n.__setitem__(0,n[0]+1) or ({'status':503,'body':b'','headers':{}} if n[0]==1 else {'status':200,'body':b'<html>a page</html>','headers':{'content-type':'text/html'}});f.madeup_text('https://h.example.com/a/b');f.madeup_text('https://h.example.com/c/d');print(n[0]);sys.exit(0 if n[0]==2 else 1)

import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e)
        sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import factdiff as f, provider as p
for status in (200, 404, 410):
    f._madeup.clear()
    n = [0]
    def req(u, **k):
        n[0] += 1
        return {"status": status, "body": b"<html>a page</html>", "headers": {"content-type": "text/html"}}
    p.gated_request = req
    f.madeup_text("https://h.example.com/a/b")
    f.madeup_text("https://h.example.com/c/d")
    assert n[0] == 1, (status, "a 200, 404 or 410 answer of the made-up sibling is no longer kept for the host", n[0])
